claims.statement: For every affine-subspace indicator q of codimension r and every Boolean F, Eraw(Fq)<=H(F)+Eraw(q)=H(F)+2r E[q]. Every signing b with |b|=q satisfies Eraw(b)>=Eraw(q), so the corrected coherent endpoint H(F)-Eraw(Fq)+Eraw(b) is nonnegative.
claims.scope: All finite dimensions, codimensions, affine shifts, Boolean F, and signings; restriction hereditary.

claims.statement: If every physical coordinate is transverse to the affine support of a signed mask b, then Eraw(b)<=4 I(b), with equality for point support.
claims.scope: Arbitrary sign pattern on the affine support; constant 4 independent of dimension, codimension, density and overlap.

claims.statement: The universal inequality Eraw(Fq)<=H(F)+Eraw(q) fails on the corrected seven-bit X007 witness by 0.122617694991922... bits. A repair c H(2q-1) requires c>=0.294682136281410... on that witness.
claims.scope: Exact Boolean F and indicator q; sign certified by an exact prime-exponent integer comparison.

claims.statement: Affine disagreement supports now have a complete signed-collision ledger and a sharp source-piece influence payment under transversality. Arbitrary supports still require a single-use affine-mixture or activation credit.
